title: Beta feedback
description: One tester's answers at one beta checkpoint, at <venture>/validation/feedback/<id>.json. The beta gate (schema/beta-gate.mjs) unlocks the next capability only once this record exists for the previous one. routed_to is where the feedback went and routing how that was decided.

tester.description: An anonymous id (NAIVE_BETA_TESTER), never a name or email: it is part of the record's file name

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint whose form these answer

routed_to.description: The route the feedback was filed under (product/bugs, validation/feedback, ...)

fallback.description: True when the injected fallback decided, not Jev
